verdict.rationale: Angular's own CLI provides scriptable commands for building, unit testing, end-to-end testing, linting, deploying, updating and cache management. These are the building blocks of a headless CI pipeline, and they are first-party capabilities rather than user workarounds. However, the evidence never explicitly documents CI usage, headless test runs, or non-interactive automation modes. missing for 10: explicit CI/headless documentation (e.g. non-interactive flags, headless browser test runs, CI configuration guidance), independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.
